title: Very tame action on an fs log scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme with log morphisms, geometric stalks and nonunit ideals as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and let a finite group $G$ act on $X$ as in [def-per-fs-log-group-action]. The action is very tame if it is tame and, for every geometric point $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, its inertia group acts trivially on $\overline M_t=M_t/\mathcal O_{X,t}^{\times}$ and on $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{X,t}/I_t)$, where $I_t$ is the nonunit log ideal. Explicitly, for every inertia element and every pointed relative etale diagram representing its pullback, each log section and its pullback have associated germs (differ by a unit), and every regular function and its pullback have germs differing by an element of $I_t$. These tests on all germs specify the actual action on the characteristic monoid and strict local stratum.
